_comment: P2-A/P2-C billing-map: maps (provider, auth_profile) -> billing_mode. Copy to store/billing-map.json (gitignored) and fill with your real accounts. There is NO provider-name heuristic: any (provider, auth_profile) pair NOT listed here resolves to 'unknown' (never a false 'free'). Valid billing_mode values: subscription_included | subscription_credit | api_payg | local_compute | unknown. These entries are ILLUSTRATIVE placeholders, not real account data.
_provider: provider comes from costops/pricing.ts deriveProvider(model): anthropic | openai | deepseek | google | xai | mistral | meta | unknown.
_auth_profile: auth_profile is what P2-C stamps on a dispatch, in one of exactly three namespaced forms: 'plan:<id>' for an agent bound to a named Claude plan (a store/claude-plans.json id); 'configdir:<path-relative-to-$HOME>' for an agent bound to a raw claudeConfigDir, and for the agent-worker's isolated dir; 'host_default' for an agent bound to neither, i.e. running on Claude Code's default config dir. An absolute path is never stored. To see the values YOUR install produces: SELECT DISTINCT provider, auth_profile FROM dispatches.
